entities.name: UDP-diacylglucosamine hydrolase
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt references A4Y5H7 and A1RL94; EC 3.6.1.54.
Hydrolyzes UDP-2,3-diacylglucosamine to lipid X (2,3-diacylglucosamine 1-phosphate) and UMP by water attack at the alpha-phosphorus; participates in lipid A biosynthesis.
Reference annotation reports two Mn2+ ions per subunit in a binuclear metal center.

entities.name: UDP-diacylglucosamine hydrolysis
observations: Rhea RHEA:25213: UDP-2-N,3-O-bis[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-alpha-D-glucosamine + H2O → corresponding glucosaminyl 1-phosphate (lipid X) + UMP + 2 H+.
